questions.question: Is extra pay required for weekend or night work?
questions.source: DOL Wage and Hour Division, FLSA FAQ
questions.reference: No, not under the FLSA (a matter of agreement)

questions.question: When must breaks and meal periods be given?
questions.source: DOL Wage and Hour Division, FLSA FAQ
questions.reference: FLSA does not require them; short breaks if given are compensable

questions.question: When is overtime due?
questions.source: DOL Wage and Hour Division, FLSA FAQ

questions.question: How many hours per day or per week can an employee work?
questions.source: DOL Wage and Hour Division, FLSA FAQ
questions.expect_authority: FLSA (no limit for 16+); 29 U.S.C. § 212 for minors
questions.reference: FLSA sets no limit for workers 16 and older

questions.question: Are pay stubs required?
questions.source: DOL Wage and Hour Division, FLSA FAQ
questions.reference: FLSA does not require pay stubs; it requires records

questions.question: Do I need an attorney to file a job discrimination complaint with the EEOC?
How much time do I have to report job discrimination to the EEOC?
questions.reference: 180 days, extended to 300 where a state/local agency enforces a similar law
